en_title: Xbox's First-Ever Chief Operating Officer Leaves Role Just Three Months After It Was Created
cn_title: XBOX首任COO任职三个月后离职
subtitle: 人事变动再起
opus_summary: XBOX首任首席运营官Helen Chiang在职位设立三个月后离职。她此前负责《我的世界》业务，并在XBOX工作了21年。微软仍在持续重组，预计今年将有3,200名员工失业。

paragraphs.en: Helen Chiang, Xbox’s first-ever chief operating officer, has abdicated the role just three months after it was created, as told by CEO Asha Sharma in an internal memo today.
paragraphs.cn: 据CEO Asha Sharma今日发布的内部备忘录透露，XBOX首任首席运营官Helen Chiang在该职位设立仅三个月后便卸任。

paragraphs.en: The memo, verified by The Verge , included a brief statement from Sharma regarding Chiang’s exit. “Helen Chiang is leaving Microsoft today. I’m grateful for her years of service and wish her well,” Sharma said. “We’ll share more on COO leadership as plans are finalized.”
paragraphs.cn: The Verge核实了这份备忘录，其中包含Sharma针对Chiang离职发表的简短声明。Sharma表示：「Helen Chiang将于今日离开微软。感谢她多年来的服务，祝她未来一切顺利。」「待相关计划确定后，我们会进一步公布COO职位的人事安排。」

paragraphs.en: Chiang had been with Xbox for an astonishing 21 years. Previously, she was in charge of the Minecraft franchise, and shifted roles to chief operating officer in July 2026.
paragraphs.cn: Chiang在XBOX工作了惊人的21年。她此前负责《我的世界》系列业务，并于2026年7月转任首席运营官。

paragraphs.en: The reason for Chiang’s promotion and the job duties of the COO were outlined in a statement by Sharma amid news of Xbox’s massive restructuring this summer. According to Sharma, the role was necessary to “work toward a shared goal, make the right tradeoffs, and get things done” as Xbox’s headcount grew and the company became “more fragmented.”
paragraphs.cn: 今年夏天，XBOX大规模重组的消息传出后，Sharma曾在一份声明中说明Chiang获得晋升的原因以及COO的职责。Sharma表示，随着XBOX员工人数增加、公司变得「更加分散」，设立这一职位是为了「朝着共同目标努力，做出正确取舍，并完成各项工作」。

paragraphs.en: “For the first time, we are establishing a Chief Operating Officer with end-to-end P&L responsibility across content, hardware, platform, and services. Helen Chiang has been promoted to this role and will report directly to me,” Sharma said at the time.
paragraphs.cn: Sharma当时表示：「我们首次设立首席运营官一职，负责内容、硬件、平台和服务业务的端到端损益。Helen Chiang已获晋升，将直接向我汇报。」

paragraphs.en: “Over nearly two decades at Xbox, Helen has helped build some of our most important businesses, from Xbox Live to leading Mojang and the Minecraft franchise. She will bring our businesses together under one operating model, making sure we make clear investment decisions, learn from our successes and failures, and hold ourselves accountable for results.”
paragraphs.cn: 「Helen在XBOX工作近20年，帮助我们建立了多个最重要的业务，从XBOX Live到领导Mojang和《我的世界》系列。她将把我们的各项业务整合到同一套运营模式下，确保我们做出清晰的投资决策，从成功与失败中吸取经验，并对成果负责。」

paragraphs.en: As noted by The Verge, the reason for Chiang’s brief tenure in this specific role has not yet been divulged, but it’s certainly a striking move, given her 21 years with the company prior to this.
paragraphs.cn: 正如The Verge所指出的，Chiang在这一具体职位上任期如此短暂的原因尚未公布。不过，考虑到她此前已在这家公司工作了21年，这无疑是一次引人注目的人事变动。

paragraphs.en: Xbox is predicted to continue layoffs as part of its ongoing internal restructuring, with 3,200 total employees expected to lose their jobs this year. Several studios have been divested as a result of this rework, though some have managed to find their footing, as is the case with Double Fine .
paragraphs.cn: 预计XBOX将继续裁员，以推进正在进行的内部重组，预计今年共有3,200名员工失去工作。此次重组还导致多家工作室被剥离，不过其中一些工作室已经找到新的立足点，Double Fine便是其中之一。

paragraphs.en: Others, however, remain in limbo; Arkane Lyon, the studio that’s currently working on Marvel’s Blade , faces closure as soon as mid-November if a buyer isn’t found. The studio was also impacted by the reshuffling at Microsoft, leaving both fans and industry insiders biting their nails in hope that the project finds a new home.
paragraphs.cn: 然而，其他工作室仍处于困境之中。若找不到买家，正在开发《Marvel's Blade》的Arkane Lyon最早可能于11月中旬关闭。微软此次重组也波及了该工作室，粉丝和业内人士都在焦急等待，希望这个项目能够找到新的归宿。

paragraphs.en: Other companies in the games industry aren’t faring any better. Just this week, EA announced the closure of 30-year-old RPG powerhouse BioWare , known for making games like Dragon Age, Jade Empire, and Mass Effect. The next Mass Effect game was also canceled, prompting worldwide outcry from players and calls for a boycott.
paragraphs.cn: 游戏行业的其他公司境况也没有好转。就在本周，EA宣布关闭拥有30年历史的RPG巨头BioWare。该工作室曾开发《Dragon Age》《Jade Empire》和《Mass Effect》等游戏。下一部《Mass Effect》游戏也遭到取消，引发全球玩家抗议，并出现抵制呼声。

paragraphs.en: A full-length trailer for the game was also leaked online, rubbing more salt in the wound thanks to just how fantastic it looked. And while fans are crossing their fingers that EA either sells BioWare’s IP or hands them over to another studio, analysts say this isn’t likely. Oh, well — at least the Prime Video series is still alive.
paragraphs.cn: 这款游戏的完整预告片也遭到泄露，并因其出色的画面表现让这场打击更加令人难受。粉丝希望EA出售BioWare的知识产权，或将其交给另一家工作室，但分析师表示这不太可能。唉，至少Prime Video剧集还没有取消。
